title: Overview
description: A high-level introduction to the React library, its purpose, core principles, and how the documentation is structured.

title: Getting Started
description: A step-by-step guide to setting up a new project and creating your first React component.

title: Core APIs
description: Understand the fundamental building blocks of React applications, from components and JSX to context and refs.

title: Components & Props
description: Learn how to create and compose UI using function and class components, and how to pass data using props.

title: JSX
description: Explore how to use JSX syntax to describe your UI and understand the different runtimes for client and server.

title: Creating & Manipulating Elements
description: Learn about `createElement`, `cloneElement`, and other utilities for working with React elements directly.

title: Refs
description: Access and interact with DOM nodes or React components directly using `createRef` and `forwardRef`.

title: Context
description: Pass data through the component tree without having to pass props down manually at every level.

title: Children Utilities
description: Work with the `props.children` opaque data structure using the `React.Children` API helpers.

title: Hooks
description: A detailed guide to all the built-in Hooks that let you use state and other React features without writing a class.

title: State Hooks
description: Manage component's state with `useState`, `useReducer`, `useActionState`, and `useOptimistic`.

title: Effect Hooks
description: Perform side effects in your components with `useEffect`, `useLayoutEffect`, and `useInsertionEffect`.

title: Ref Hooks
description: Reference values that aren’t needed for rendering with `useRef` and `useImperativeHandle`.

title: Performance Hooks
description: Optimize your components' performance with `useCallback`, `useMemo`, `useTransition`, and `useDeferredValue`.

title: Other Hooks
description: Explore other Hooks like `useContext`, `useId`, `useDebugValue`, and `useSyncExternalStore`.

title: Advanced Guides
description: Dive deeper into more complex React features, patterns, and environments.

title: Server vs. Client Environments
description: Understand the differences between React's server and client environments and their respective APIs.

title: Code Splitting with `lazy` and `Suspense`
description: Improve app performance by loading components only when they are needed.

title: Caching
description: Learn how to use React's caching capabilities for data fetching and memoization on both client and server.

title: Transitions
description: Manage complex UI updates without blocking the main thread using `startTransition` and `useTransition`.

title: Experimental APIs
description: Explore experimental and unstable APIs, including security features like Taint and the `postpone` function.

title: API Reference
description: A comprehensive, A-Z reference for all public React APIs, including components, hooks, and utilities.

title: Package Exports
description: Details on the different entry points provided by the 'react' package, such as `jsx-runtime` and `compiler-runtime`.
